other_failure_modes.name: Invalid submission format (hard labels instead of probabilities)
other_failure_modes.description: For tasks evaluated on metrics like log loss or ROC AUC, the submission format typically requires predicted probabilities for each class across multiple columns. The agent outputs a single target column with hard class labels (argmax), which discards the probability distribution and will result in an evaluation error or a severe score penalty.

other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates an artificial sequence of IDs for the submission file instead of using the provided ID column from the test set. This will cause ID mismatches during evaluation if the actual IDs do not start at 0 or are non-sequential.

summary: The agent implements a solid 5-fold cross-validation pipeline with LightGBM, avoiding most common data leakage pitfalls. However, it fails critically during the submission generation phase: it outputs hard class labels instead of the required class probabilities for the log loss metric, and it generates artificial sequential IDs instead of using the actual test set IDs. Additionally, it lacks any feature engineering, relying entirely on the raw features.
